scope: P03 CPU recording only, one local context per process, SDK v2.3.0 DX12
input: Existing shared static texture generator; zero jitter/motion, explicit exposure, preExposure 1, standard finite depth, UV motion scale 320/180, frame time 16.667 ms, camera 0.1/100/pi-over-3/1. Reset only frame zero. No masks, HDR, sharpening or dynamic sizing.
timing: Both consumers call the same helper QPC exports. One timer bracket around dispatch; setup, frame construction, submission, fence, sentinel restore, readback, output copy and logging excluded. Full wrapper includes validation; minimal C++ and prepared Rust raw do not. No empty timer subtraction.
validity: Pinned SDK/signatures/ABI; matching provider and canonical descriptors; untouched-sentinel control; each final output independently overwrites sentinel; exact RGBA16F output hashes agree within each frame-count cohort; separate debug controls and zero device removal. Invalid comparisons reject rather than receive speed scores.
statistics: Retain warmup and measured samples. Compare nearby process medians within each block, not individual frames across processes. Descriptive distributions and signed differences, no speed gate or equivalence claim. Warm-state controls assess sensitivity but cannot isolate scheduling/clock changes.
